description:
The clue to a healthy, adequate adult life lies somewhere we often don't look: in our childhoods. It's in childhood that, if things go more or less right, we learn the most important lessons about life at the hands of those who love us.  Being given love isn't simply pleasant, it quite literally saves and educates us.

description:
When love is working, we desperately want it to last forever. We demand promises for the next half century, building our emotional lives on the illusion of absolute permanence. 
Start your free Membership trial – 2,000+ articles, 1,000+ videos, 50+ courses, free for a week: https://www.theschooloflife.com/membership 
Yet everything in us and around us is in constant motion, and our history is full of things we thought would never end. In this film, we explore the liberating philosophy of impermanence, showing how accepting that nothing is promised can actually free us to deeply savor today.

"When love is working, we want it to last - inevitably - forever. It isn’t enough that it should have been nice today and that we’ve plans for tomorrow. We beg them to promise that they will be with us until the end. A dog can be happy in the present moment; we’re aren’t satisfied until we’ve secured the next half century..."
